metadata.description: Decidable API design guidance: a seven-principle, shape-neutral philosophy plus curated case studies from large-scale data APIs. Borrow the philosophy, never the shape.

plugins.name: oh-my-coding
plugins.description: Coding skill for designing and evolving APIs. Applies seven decidable invariants — one operation envelope, bounded verbs, cursor-first pagination, request-scoped idempotency, additive evolution, two-layer machine-readable errors, projection as parameter — with project contracts taking precedence over curated reference case studies.
